upstream.version: 0.5.10.post2.dev438 snapshot (the tree docs/architecture.md cites); scanned as a vendored copy without its git history, so scanned_commit is null

limits: Static: the scan cannot tell which functions a workload reaches. Shares are of the source tree, not of the code a run executes.
Only rules with basis 'syntax' are firm. 'default_op' (no rule matched) assumes a per-call function body; such a function may run once at start-up or only inside a captured graph.
'covered' means the lab has the install path and reaches the file. It is not a receipt: no edit was installed and no witness read.
Nested functions and lambdas count with the function that encloses them. Files that do not parse are counted in 'unparsed' and in no share.
Native sources are counted by file and line, apart from the Python shares.
Lines are non-blank lines that are not only a comment; docstrings count.
